What language do I start? What are the differences? Is there an index to easily look up all these acronyms?
I have no idea where to start.

I think it's best to pick a language and just start learning it. It's also good to have motivating examples, e.g. try to make a text game about something you're interested in. You'll pick up the basics via online tutorials like BurtmacklinFBI- said, and the practice of making a game will help solidify things. If you don't know what language to start with, try Python. You can usually turn up information about acronyms by googling the acronym along with the word 'acronym', like "LRU acronym". Hope this helps a little!

if you have no idea where to start then I recommend just starting with books that teach basic programming concepts over focusing too much on what language to learn. Once you are familiar with basic concepts like design patterns, loops, conditional statements etc. Then you can go from one language to another relatively easy.

check out http://learnpythonthehardway.org/book/ or the head first series is good too.

I also highly recommend http://www.theodinproject.com/ if you want to full stack web development.
